quarterly_data.signal: Adobe's 10-Q: cost of subscription revenue rose to $633 million in the three months ended August 28, 2026 from $510 million a year earlier (+24%), and hosting services and data center costs are the largest listed component of that increase - a 22% component of the 24% change for the three months, and a 17% component of the 17% change for the nine months (to $1,759 million from $1,505 million).
